title: Optimal Model Activation Policies for Inference Networks of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have rendered them necessary for Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, and their high inference cost motivates the study of cost-performance trade-offs. In practice, several expert LLMs are used in synergy for inference, either in an ensemble mode or in series, yet without a principled approach on how to best use the available models. An adaptive approach can route simple queries to cheaper LLMs and complex ones to more capable, costly models. However, a clear understanding on how to best leverage available expert models is missing. We introduce inference networks, a graph-based framework, where nodes denote different LLMs, and links denote conditional model activations. The inference network design problem is to determine the best topology, namely the best way to use the models that best addresses the cost-performance trade-off. translated_title: 大语言模型推理网络的最优模型激活策略
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使其成为自然语言处理（NLP）任务的必需品，其高昂的推理成本推动了对成本-性能权衡的研究。在实践中，多个专家LLM以协同方式用于推理，可以采用集成模式或串联模式，但目前缺乏关于如何最佳使用可用模型的原则性方法。一种自适应方法可以将简单查询路由到更便宜的LLM，将复杂查询路由到更强大、成本更高的模型。然而，关于如何最好地利用可用的专家模型，仍然缺乏清晰的理解。我们引入了推理网络这一基于图的框架，其中节点表示不同的LLM，链路表示条件模型激活。推理网络设计问题是确定最佳拓扑结构，即以最佳方式使用模型来最好地解决成本-性能权衡问题。我们从一系列LLM专家的基本拓扑结构开始（此处摘要似乎不完整）。
tldr: 本文提出推理网络这一基于图的框架来协调多个大语言模型协同推理，通过确定最优网络拓扑结构将简单查询路由给低成本模型、复杂查询路由给高能力模型，从而优化推理的成本-性能权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces inference networks, a graph-based framework for orchestrating multiple LLMs in inference, and addresses the network design problem of finding the optimal topology for conditional model activation to best balance the cost-performance trade-off by routing simple queries to cheaper models and complex ones to more capable ones.
